title: LuckRead D1-05 Analytics Owner Boundary
purpose: Define W11-exclusive access and derived-data limits for the fifth canonical D1 domain without claiming physical provisioning or runtime readiness.
authority: Analytics-only derived data and analytics processing state; not a business source of truth.
boundaryRules: W11 is the only Worker allowed to read/write D1-05.
D1-05 contains derived analytics state only and never becomes the source of truth for identity, content publication, social relationships, entitlements, commerce or financial facts.
W03/W05/W07 authoritative writes must not wait for D1-05 persistence.
Only already admitted event/API delivery contracts may feed D1-05; this contract creates no Worker, Queue, Service Binding or transport.
Metrics must be deduplicated, versioned, privacy-filtered and reconcilable to authoritative source facts.
Retention, deletion, consent/purpose, indexes, batch size, replay and rebuild behavior require explicit implementation contracts.
A null or absent physical database UUID means the domain is not provisioned; no runtime binding may be inferred from this contract.
